title: Tribes critical power relative error
statement: For each natural number $w$, let $d_w$ denote the critical dimension used in the tribes construction. Define the critical power relative error to be $2^w\log(d_w)/d_w-1$, where $\log$ is the natural logarithm.
caveat: The payload gives no definition of the critical dimension, so its meaning cannot be made self-contained beyond naming it.
